description: List checked-in Meshy animation catalog options for humanoid generated models. This is a read-only catalog/search tool and does not start animation. Results are ranked for coding-agent selection: generic walk queries prefer neutral walk cycles, while gendered/style-specific motions require explicit query terms. Use query/category to narrow options, then pass selected action IDs to animate_generated_model.
name: list_model_animation_options
title: List Model Animation Options
